whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a dependency ranged with `~` under a zero major version.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a dependency ranged with `~` under a zero major version.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm package.json no longer carries a dependency ranged with `~` under a zero major version.
